channel.title: Fight Intelligence: picks and results
channel.description: The model's pick for every announced UFC fight, saved before the card, and how it did once the results were in. For fun and learning, not betting advice.

item.title: Results: UFC 333: Volkanovski vs. Evloev (2026-10-24)
item.description: The model got 6 of 14 right. Biggest miss: Movsar Evloev at 93%, but Alexander Volkanovski won.
